# OpenAI Codex Quota Reset Radar (CodexReset.live)
> Source-first radar for public OpenAI Codex quota resets, verified developer signals, and personal 5-hour rolling limit recovery calculators.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Live Reset Radar](https://codexresetlive.com/#calendar): Real-time tracker for public quota resets announced by OpenAI lead engineers.
- [5-Hour Limit Calculator](https://codexresetlive.com/#calculator): Interactive recovery countdown and rolling quota estimator.
- [Reset Mechanics FAQ](https://codexresetlive.com/#faq): In-depth breakdown between hard rate limits, banked tokens, and server throttles.
- [Community Signal Repository](https://github.com/tangtang-it/codexresetlive): Official open-source GitHub hub for submitting community reset evidence.
